## Requirements (contract)

1. **Isolated submission/receipt/moderation storage + a public receiver role
   with no claim-spine or curator writes; existing curation stays
   loopback-only.**
2. **No-JS form, allowlisted record/release/evidence-reference fields,
   bounded narrative, receipt secret and safe status transitions; no uploads,
   no server-side URL fetches.**
3. **Abuse limits, ephemeral rate identifiers, retention/purge policy,
   redaction, operating owner + review-response disclosure, and a
   deployment/operating gate packet — never assuming staffing.**

### Out of scope (must NOT do)

- P32.16a's authorized correction-application bridge (`applied`/`published`
  stay reserved — the writer guard refuses them for every current role).
- No deploy/publish/live exposure (GATE-G3; `live_verification=false`); no
  source-rights flips, human labels, gate signatures, outreach or main
  integration; no landed-ADR rewrites or claim-history edits; no spine
  `UPDATE`/`DELETE`.

## Design (ADR-135)

- **Three processes, three trust levels.** `sig-api serve-intake` is a new
  third process (`api/src/api/intake.py`) — never mounted on the read API,
  never sharing the loopback curation app; both directions asserted in tests.
- **`intake` sqitch change** (`db/deploy|revert|verify/intake_storage.sql` +
  `db/src/db/intake.py`): quarantined `intake.report` (immutable identity
  columns, expungeable payload), restricted `intake.reporter_contact`,
  digest-only `intake.receipt`, append-only restricted `intake.event`, and
  the definer-owned coarse `intake.report_public` projection. Two NOLOGIN
  roles — `sig_intake_receiver` (INSERT payloads + projection/digest reads
  only) and `sig_intake_reviewer` (SELECT payloads + INSERT reviewer events +
  maintenance EXECUTE); a `current_setting('role')` writer guard pins
  `received` to the receiver role and reviewer events to the reviewer role;
  `applied`/`published` refused for every current role; **no existing role
  holds any intake grant** — the spine cannot read intake and intake cannot
  write the spine (proven live, `test_receiver_role_isolation_matrix` +
  `test_receiver_cannot_actually_write_canonical`).
- **`intake_receiver.toml` contract** (`policy/src/policy/intake.py` consumes,
  never forks): exact field allowlist, per-field bounds (20–4000-cp narrative,
  ≤10 claim ids, ≤3 https refs, 16 KiB body), the Part VIII
  pre-persistence screen (forbidden tokens separator-normalized +
  person-shaped patterns; refused payloads never reach storage or a log),
  the event vocabulary + fail-closed transition table, and the coarse
  `public_status` map.
- **Receipt capability**: `rct-<hex32>` id + ≥128-bit one-purpose status
  token; only a SHA-256 digest stored; constant-time compare; the token is
  POST-body only (never a URL), returned once at acceptance; failed lookups
  rate-limited per abuse pseudonym; uniform `unknown_receipt` 404 — no
  existence oracle. Signed `form_token` nonce doubles as the idempotency key
  — a no-JS reload re-POST yields the original receipt with `duplicate:true`,
  +0 rows.
- **Private moderation** (`api/src/api/intake_moderation.py`) rides the
  existing authenticated loopback curation app only when an intake reviewer
  store is wired: bounded priority queue, detail, append-only events with
  tier enforcement (`disposition_approved` needs `HUMAN_ASSERTION`, others
  `VERIFY_SUBMISSIONS`), 409 on illegal transitions, audited irreversible
  redaction; `public_response` disclosed only on an approved disposition
  with `public_response_publish`.
- **Abuse control**: rotating ≤24 h HMAC pseudonym over the normalized
  ingress address (5/h + burst 3, 100/h global circuit breaker, ≤10 failed
  lookups/h) — no durable IP/UA/cookie storage anywhere; Origin + Fetch
  Metadata checks, no CORS, no-store/no-referrer/CSP-`none` headers.
- **Retention**: `sig-api intake-purge` expunges payloads 30 d post-disposition
  with a 90 d review ceiling and `legal_hold` skip (dry-run + JSON report).
- **Operating gate, honestly**: `SIG_INTAKE_ENABLED` mounts; accepting reports
  needs `[intake].operational=true` + `SIG_INTAKE_OPERATIONAL=1` + both env
  secrets — all committed defaults false/empty; the form path answers the
  honest `not yet operating` page (503) and `/dispute/` says the same.

### Self-review findings → fixed in-run

- **DELETE-row trigger bug** — `intake.guard_reporter_contact_mutation`
  returned `NEW` on DELETE (NULL for deletes) so contact deletes were
  silently skipped; the redaction test caught the leftover row. Fixed to
  return `OLD` on DELETE; re-verified.
- **Mid-file `overload` import + import ordering** — E402/I001 in
  `db/src/db/intake.py` and `tests/db/test_intake_pg.py`; fixed and
  re-linted green.
- **Tuple-row connections** — psycopg default row factory returned tuples
  where dict access was assumed; store connections now pinned to
  `dict_row` with dedicated role-scoped fixtures; mypy clean (284 files).
- **ACL/probe assumptions** — `has_function_privilege('PUBLIC', …)` treated
  PUBLIC as a role name (lowered to `public` in the verify script); the
  receiver's column-level-only `receipt` SELECT is asserted via
  `has_column_privilege`; `proacl` checked without assuming brace syntax.
- **Unmapped ADR-135** — `check_backlog` flagged the new ADR until mapped
  to BL-058's `sources` cell + `BACKLOG.md` regen (same fix pattern as
  ADR-131/132/134 in-run reds).
- **Status page honesty** — the dispute page names the receiver's future
  paths but ships zero forms (`form` count 0 e2e), and `intakeAvailability`
  is a constant descriptor — a static page never probes or promises liveness.
